text.p: English and Scottish weekend soccer fixtures:
English F.A. Cup fourth round - Blackburn v Coventry
F.A. Cup fifth round - Leeds v Portsmouth, Birmingham v Wrexham, Chesterfield v Nottingham Forest, Manchester City v Middlesbrough, Wimbledon v Queens Park Rangers.
English premier league - Derby v West Ham, Tottenham v Arsenal.

English division one - Bolton v Sheffield United, Charlton v Barnsley, Grimsby v Huddersfield, Norwich v West Bromwich, Oxford v Oldham, Port Vale v Ipswich, Southend v Stoke, Wolverhampton v Crystal Palace.

English division two - Bournemouth v Burnley, Bristol Rovers v Luton, Crewe v Walsall, Millwall v Rotherham, Notts County v Blackpool, Peterborough v Bristol City, Plymouth v Bury, Preston v Wycombe, Stockport v Shrewsbury, York v Gillingham.

English division three - Carlisle v Brighton, Darlington v Scunthorpe, Doncaster v Barnet, Fulham v Wigan, Hartlepool v Torquay, Hull v Exeter, Leyton Orient v Cambridge United. Mansfield v Lincoln, Rochdale v Northampton, Swansea v Scarborough.
Scottish F.A. Cup fourth round - Brechin v Raith, Clyde v Kilmarnock, Falkirk v Dunfermline, Greenock Morton v Dundee, Motherwell v Hamilton, Rangers v East Fife.
Scottish division one - Clydebank v St Mirren
Scottish division two - Berwick v Queen of South, Stenhousemuir v Ayr.
Scottish division three -Albion v Inverness Caledonian, Cowdenbeath v Queen's Park, East Stirling v Forfar, Montrose v Arbroath, Ross County v Alloa.
English F.A. Cup fifth round - Bradford City v Sheffield Wednesday, Leicester v Chelsea
Scottish F.A. Cup fourth round - Hearts v Dundee United
Scottish F.A. Cup fourth round - Hibernian v Celtic.
